trans-unit.source: There are a number of non-profit organizations in Prague that offer support to foreigners in various aspects of integration and other life situations. Their services are provided free of charge thanks to funding from various sources, including public and private.
trans-unit.target: There are a number of non-profit organizations in Prague that offer support to foreigners in various aspects of integration and other life situations. Their services are provided free of charge thanks to funding from various sources, including public and private.

trans-unit.source: Integration Centre Prague o. p. s.
trans-unit.target: Integration Centre Prague o. p. s.

trans-unit.source: Integration Centre Prague (ICP) is a non-profit organization operating in Prague since 2012, offering free services to migrants from non-EU countries. ICP is part of a network of integration centers located across the Czech Republic.
trans-unit.target: Integration Centre Prague (ICP) is a non-profit organization operating in Prague since 2012, offering free services to migrants from non-EU countries. ICP is part of a network of integration centers located across the Czech Republic.

trans-unit.source: All ICP services are funded by European funds, the budget of the City of Prague, and other grants, making them free of charge for clients.
trans-unit.target: All ICP services are funded by European funds, the budget of the City of Prague, and other grants, making them free of charge for clients.
